tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa utpa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛtta skye 'gro'i spyi'i ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dgongs par prāstā ra bzhi stong go drug mchis pa'i nang gses gzhung gis dngos sum bstan pa uddiṣṭa drug brgya lnga pas mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// saukalpayadzambudwīpamadhyāmadharashshauddhaudanādzātaṃkarebhirdodashaṃ durbātsakāntakṛtstshasaṃdharm+mamukhāsaṃkhyodghaṭīkaḥketaweshākyanamaḥ ༄༅// bskal pa bzang po'i 'dzam gling dbus gyur 'chang*// zas gtsang sras 'khrungs bcu gnyis mdzad pa yis// smra ngan tshar gcod yang dag chos kyi sgo// grangs med 'byed po shākya'i tog la 'dud// rgyal bas lung bstan ma bzod mi srun gyis// bkums pa ma ro'i lto ba'i padmar skyes// sbyin pas skye bo tshim byas bde gshegs drung*// rab byung dgra bcom yan lag 'byung la 'dud// khyim bdag rigs 'khrungs gzhon nu srid pa 'di// sdug bsngal rang bzhin gzigs nas thub mchog la// mi phyed dad pas rab byung chos kun la// chos mig rdul bral ma pham pa la 'dud// rigs mchog bram ze las 'khrungs nyi ma'i gnyen// legs gsungs dam pa'i chos 'dul dad pa yis// rab tu byung nas zag pa'i dgra mngon bcom// sems can phan mdzad nags na gnas la 'dud// tshangs pa'i bu rigs skye ba'i sdong bu bzung*// 'phags pa ma 'gags pa las rab byung brnyes// rgyal bas dam pa'i chos bstan dur khrod du// bsgoms pas rnam grol dus ldan zhabs la 'dud// bat+sa'i rgyal bu rgyal srid chos min gyis// skyong mthong yid 'byung 'phags pa kā tyā nar// rab byung gtum po rab snang dad par byas// ston pas bsngags pa rdo rje mo bur 'dud// kha lo sgyur ba shākya rab bzangs sras// ma byung sngon nas dbul bar dam bcas bzhin// bde gshegs la phul rab byung dgra bcom thob// rdzu 'phrul 'gro 'dul bzang po pa la 'dud// khyim bdag rigs su skyes 'phral bsod nams mthus// gser gyi glang po gser gyi 'byung gnas byung*// gzhan gyis dbrog tu med de spangs nas ni// ston par rab byung gser be'u can la 'dud// bā ra dwa dza'i rigs kyi nang blon bu// bsod nams lag par gser gyi dong tse 'jo// sangs rgyas dge 'dun thabs cig bshos gtsang bstabs// rab byung zhi thob gser can mchog la 'dud// bram ze'i rigs skyes sngon bsags bsod nams mthus// nad med bde ldan rig byed pha rol son// thub pa mthong 'phral gtun ri'i rtse las mchongs// dad pas rab byung ba ku la la 'dud// lo drug mngal bzhugs don kun grub pa'i sras// the tshom chur bskyur shing bal ltar 'phyo bas// yid ches thub dbang rjes 'brang shā ri'i bur// rab byung zag zad sgra gcan 'dzin la 'dud// lam phran bzung bas gegs bral bram ze'i bu// gcen las rab byung dbang po rtul ba'i las// phyag dar gyis sbyangs rdul spong dri spong don// dpyad pas rnam grol lam phran brten la 'dud// rigs 'byor cher skyes rdo ba'i zas dran pas// bde gshegs la brten dge slong dngos por bsgrubs// bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho dregs ldan mi bdag sogs// 'gro don rab rgyas bsod snyoms len la 'dud// lam chen bzhi mdor skye 'phags smon lam mthus// 'tsho ba'i gegs bral rig byed slob dpon gyur// 'khor tshogs dang bcas bstan la rab tu byung*// zhi bsil gyur pa lam chen brten la 'dud// rgyal bu rgyal thabs skyong phyir sdig pa'i las// mi bzad spyad pas 'khor gyis bsdigs pa'i tshe// ston par skyabs gsol rab byung sdig pa sbyangs// dgra bcom la reg klu yi sde la 'dud// 'byor ldan khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu// bde gshegs chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i tshe// rab byung dgra bcom nye ba'i lnga sde yi// ya gyal 'phags pa sbed byed zhabs la 'dud// pi lindā bu thub dbang rab byung brnyes// rang dbon khye'u rnams dang lha 'bangs nor// lwa ba'i gos rnams chom rkun khyer brtsam tshe// rdzu 'phrul gyis bzlog mi phyed pa la 'dud// ha la shan rir gnas brtan tshogs 'chag tshe// phyag dar gyis mtshon dgyes pa'i phrin las bsgrubs// srog chags bsrung phyir sprul pa'i stag mo 'gyed// sangs rgyas zhal mthong dharma tā lar 'dud// dbugs 'byin gyur tshe 'od srungs skyabs su song*// bslab gzhi legs blangs smon lam lhan cig btab// deng dus rgyal chen ris skyes zas gtsang sras// dgyes bskyed bden mthong yul 'khor srung la 'dud// dbugs cher 'byin tshe 'od srungs skyabs su song*// bslab gzhi legs blangs smon lam mnyam btab mthus// deng dus rgyal chen ris skyes shākya thub// dgyes bskyed bden mthong 'phags skyes po la 'dud// 'gro dbang gyur tshe 'od srungs skyabs su song*// bslab gzhi legs blangs smon lam lhan cig btab// deng dus rgyal chen ris skyes de bzhin gshegs// dgyes bskyed bden mthong mig mi bzang la 'dud// gtsug dbang gyur tshe 'od srungs skyabs su song*// bslab gzhi legs blangs smon lam mnyam btab mthus// deng dus rgyal chen ris skyes shākya'i gtso// dgyes bskyed bden mthong rnam thos bu la 'dud// rgyal po bro 'tshal gang tshe gsol btab bzhin// gnas brtan bcu drug gis byon snyun las grol// dbyar gnas spyan drangs gtsang khang brtsigs mchod sogs// skal bzang rgya nag thang dzu'i dzung la bsngags// bde gshegs sprul pa dgra bcom bcu drug la// rtogs brjod tshul gyis cung zad bstod pa'i dge

/rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa der 'dzin bcas// nor 'dzin kun tu khyab par rgyal phyir bsngo// thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bzhad pa las// mkha' mnyam lus can rkang pa drug ldan sogs// zab rgyas chos tshul sbrang rtsi len byed cing*// kun dga' sar pa'i 'phur lding bsgyur bar shog /bdag kyang byang chub bar gyi skye ba kun// tshul khrims dag ldan gtsug lag rab 'byams kyi// snang ba yongs su bzung nas rgyal ba'i bstan// gsal byed smra ba'i nyi ma mchog gyur cig /ces thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa utpal phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni gnas brtan bcu drug gi rtogs brjod ri mor 'dri ba'i tshe mtshan byang du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yantu/ gang zhig mthong bas sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi /chu gter mtha' med srid pas yid 'byung gang*// bag yod spyod pa'i gru chen legs bzung nas// mngon mtho nges legs rin chen gling bgrod byed// rgyal bas legs gsungs chos 'dul gnas mal gzhir// nyer bstan srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa'i// gzugs brnyan gyis mtshan gtsug lag khang gi sgo// thar par 'bod pa'i pho nya dang po'i 'phrin// 'di bris dge tshogs bsngo ba'i rgyang glu yis// lus can yid kyi ri dwags nyer bcings nas// ltar snang bde ba'i smig rgyur ma chags par// bslab gzhi'i dga' tshal 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang du 'dri bar 'os pa srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa kha byang bcas 'di bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
